name: User Expresses Frustration with HR Policies
goal: Assess how the bot responds to user frustration regarding company HR policies.
constraints: Bot should acknowledge the user's feelings and offer to provide information or escalate if needed. No defensive or dismissive language.

phases.description: User expresses strong frustration about the annual leave carryover policy change.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot acknowledges the frustration and offers to explain the policy or escalate.

phases.description: User asks for more details about the policy.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot provides accurate details about the annual leave carryover policy.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
